responsibility: Declares the LoongArch GCC driver spec hooks and assembles the driver self-spec logic for machine options. It exposes the helper functions implemented in loongarch-driver.cc, defines EXTRA_SPEC_FUNCTIONS, and builds spec fragments that capture -mabi, -march, -mtune, -mfpu, -mcmodel, and float-mode switches so the driver can normalize them and derive ABI-related spec substitutions such as dynamic linker names.
same_name_distinction: Defines the GCC driver spec integration for the loongarch-driver pair, including EXTRA_SPEC_FUNCTIONS and self-spec macros that wire LoongArch option capture into the driver. Unlike loongarch-driver.cc, it mainly declares hooks and assembles spec strings instead of performing normalization itself.
